children: Westhawk AS, a company owned by Åge Westbø, board member and primary insider in Goodtech ASA, has on 2 November 2026 purchased 9,000 shares in Goodtech ASA at an average price of NOK 13.90 per share.
Following the transaction, Åge Westbø and associates, holds 2,790,000 shares in Goodtech ASA.
Please see the attached form for further details.

This information has been submitted pursuant to the Securities Trading Act § 5-12 and MAR. The information was submitted for publication, through the agency of the contact persons set out above, at 2026-11-03 08:30 CET.
